title: POS instance v1
description: What the ERP knows about the POS instance holding the credential: `GET /api/v1/pos/instance`. A POS reads it when it connects, to learn its own code and the branches it serves.

code.description: The instance's code, which every sales event names as `posInstance`.

contractVersion.description: The version of this contract the ERP serves, semver. A POS written against 1.x works with any 1.y.

branches.description: The branches this instance may sell for, by ecosystem location code. A sales event for any other branch is refused.
